items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I don't recall. I don't recall when he left or why they left or what it was all about. Because, I don't know, I don't remember.

ctx.x: Johnny Hodges. Johnny Hodges was out of the band from about 1951 to about 1954. And he replaced him with Willie Smith. And Lawrence Brown was out a little bit longer than that, I think. He came in much later.

I was out, '52. I don't recall. I don't recall when he left or why they left or what it was all about. Because, I don't know, I don't remember. I really don't remember. I couldn't be quoted as saying nothing like that. No way.
